Indian hackers breached OpenAI systems using Claude, earned bounty

A cybersecurity startup from India successfully breached OpenAI's systems by exploiting vulnerabilities in Anthropic's Claude AI model. The hackers were awarded a bounty of approximately ₹6.27 lakh (or $6,500 USD) for identifying and reporting the security flaw. The incident highlights a novel method of system intrusion utilizing advanced AI tools.
